description: This file defines the 'ShippingOption' class, a model representing shipping options in a sales or e-commerce system, including properties like price, code, name, delivery dates, and description.

classes.name: ShippingOption
classes.description: Model class representing a shipping option with attributes such as price, name, code, delivery and shipping dates, description, and estimated days.

methods.name: getOptionPrice
methods.description: Returns the shipping option price, converting from text if necessary.

methods.name: getOptionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionName
methods.description: Sets the name of the shipping option.

methods.name: getOptionPriceText
methods.description: Returns the text representation of the option price.

methods.name: setOptionPriceText
methods.description: Sets the text representation of the option price.

methods.name: getOptionId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: setOptionId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the shipping option.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the shipping option.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the shipping option.

methods.name: getEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Returns the estimated number of days for delivery.

methods.name: setEstimatedNumberOfDays
methods.description: Sets the estimated number of days for delivery.
